name: Sheltering With You
source:
A difficult journey to the East awaits Helena, an orphan, and Aya, a former brothel worker. At the same time, a certain Monster attacks the villages, and Helena sees strange dreams. On the way, the girls meet a daughter of the northern lord Liana, who is forced to hide under a wing of a flower seller and be under the strict supervision of her companion Rahl. Will Helena agree to join their company or will she continue her adventure with Aya? What kind of unusual life stories do the main characters keep in their hearts? Will Helena respond to the call of her dreams, or will she find happiness in big love? It all depends on the player!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276410/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
孤儿海伦娜与曾在妓院工作的阿雅，即将踏上一段艰难的东行旅程。与此同时，某个怪物正在袭击村庄，海伦娜也不断做着奇异的梦。旅途中，女孩们遇见了北方领主的女儿莉安娜。她被迫躲在一位花贩的庇护之下，还受到同行者拉尔的严密看管。海伦娜会答应与她们同行，还是继续和阿雅一起冒险？主人公们心中各自藏着怎样不同寻常的人生故事？海伦娜会回应梦境的呼唤，还是在深切的爱情中找到幸福？一切都由玩家决定！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276410/]Steam[/url]]
